title: Chladni plate
description: Granular dark nodes gather into the standing-wave patterns of a pale steel plate.
useCase: Make resonance structure visible through discrete plate modes.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Analytic nodal amplitude with deterministic grain, not a sand particle simulation or audio input.
look: Square pale steel plate on dusty blue-grey, speckled with dark grain that collects into crossing diagonal lines and rings, with a thin inset rim.
motion: Dark grains thicken and thin along the standing-wave nodal lines in a slow pulse of about 9.5 s; the mode slider snaps the plate to discrete patterns; a button pauses.
adapt: The pattern is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `u_control` picks integer `mode` and `b` for `wave`, `nodes` sets line sharpness and its `sin(u_time*.33)` pulse, and `salt` sets grain density. Recolour `bg` and `metal`; keep the canvas lifecycle and fallback.
